method: Interior window after physical ATA and before physical NO CARRIER. Percentages weight perf periods, not raw sample counts.
interpretation: Training is dominated by native C5x/device execution and native x86, with Python a much smaller share than the whole attempt.
Whole-attempt yield totals cannot identify training-only callback causes; no attempt is made to infer those counts from perf sample shares.
Prioritize measured DSP execution work; previous BE/BF generic dispatch experiment was rejected and should not be repeated without new evidence.
Sampled symbols are statistical hotspots, not exact guest instruction frequencies or proof of optimization benefit.
